language.name: English
language.label: Language
engine.unavailable: Engine state unavailable: restart the application.
setup.fail.disk: Not enough disk space: free some, then retry. What is already downloaded is kept.
setup.fail.site: The site {site} does not answer. Check the Internet connection; if it works, the site is probably down: retry in a few minutes. What is already downloaded is kept.
setup.fail.some_site: A download site does not answer. Check the Internet connection; if it works, the site is probably down: retry in a few minutes. What is already downloaded is kept.
setup.error.no_bundle: Not an AppImage: nothing to install.
setup.error.key: API key refused: an NVIDIA key starts with “nvapi-”.
app.status.pick_window: Choose the game window to share…
app.tab.map_level: From level 3 (Countries): the map reveals the countries.
app.mark.hint: Freezes the view full screen to draw a box around clues (Super+Shift+Z).
app.mark.need_capture: Take a capture first: the marks complete the round's analysis.
app.country_locked.detail: Country locked ({country}): nothing left to tell apart between countries. Reject the lock if you doubt it.
app.welcome.title: One view, a few clues.
app.welcome.capture_after: : the coach shows on its own the help of the level chosen above, from “Look” (where to search, revealing nothing) to “Answer” (the country and the proof).
app.welcome.mark_after: freezes the view to draw a box around a detail (plate, sign): the AI reads it enlarged.
proof.marks_likely: Very likely: read in your marks
proof.ai_strong: Very likely: read by the AI, to be confirmed
proof.ai_medium: Likely: read by the AI, to be confirmed
engine.erased_restart: Data erased. Restart the application to start from scratch.
engine.no_browser: The browser could not be opened.
level.1.hint: Where to look, naming no country
level.2.hint: Plus what the AI sees, including the text read
level.3.hint: Plus the likely countries, their clues and the Plonk It tips
level.4.hint: Plus the synthesis: country, region if a text names it, and the proof
look.none: No meta tells apart the likely countries of this view.
metas.none: No meta tells these countries apart. Add your own in ~/.config/geonesclick/my-metas.toml.
tips.ranked: Ranked by similarity to the image: a lead to check, not a certainty.
tips.preparing: The tips close to the view appear on the next captures, once they are prepared.
vision.off: The vision model is turned off in the configuration.
vision.no_answer: The vision model did not answer.
summary.mark_against: {mark} points to {country} ({items}): a doubtful reading? If it is wrong, remove it in “Marks” and the answer will become certain.
summary.clip_other: StreetCLIP leaned towards {country} ({pct}): the proof read wins.
summary.check_text: Check the text yourself: the model sometimes misreads it.
summary.from_look: From the look of the view (StreetCLIP), without written proof.
summary.no_standout: The look of the view is not enough to decide: no country stands out.
summary.alphabet: Alphabet of your marks: {scripts}. Only possible: {flags}.
summary.rejected: On the whole view, the AI thought it read a proof for {country} ({proof}): ruled out, the alphabet of your marks excludes it.
summary.deep_pending: In-depth analysis running: if it reads a written proof, it will show here.
summary.unreadable_after: at this size: zoom on it in the game, then capture again. It often settles it.
summary.look_for: Look for text, a plate or a domain; otherwise, “What tells them apart” says what to observe.
countries.clip_gave: From the look of the view alone, StreetCLIP gave {pct}.
countries.clip_absent: StreetCLIP did not count it among its likely countries.
countries.ruled_out_aria: Countries ruled out by the proof
countries.ruled_out_by_alphabet: Ruled out by the alphabet of your marks
marks.street_name: street name, does not locate the view
marks.lone_place: a mere clue: a place concludes only with another proof
marks.unreadable: Unreadable text: draw a tighter box around it, or zoom in the game then mark again.
marks.here_title: You are in {city}: tell the coach (careful, a direction sign names a place where you are not)
marks.small: Small originally (enlarged ×{scale}): enlarging does not invent details. If some text is missing, zoom on it in the game then mark it closely.
marks.remove_title: Wrong reading or bad crop: the mark will no longer count in the answer.
marks.footer: Read by the AI, word for word; concluded by the coach's rules (place names: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0). Add marks with
locks.ai_proof: The AI read a proof for {country}{proof}.
locks.marks_lean: your marks point this way (very likely)
locks.alphabet_excludes: the {scripts} alphabet ({marks}) is not written in this country
locks.ask: Do you know where you are? Tell the coach:
locks.type_other: … or type to search another country
locks.hidden: the coach is sure of it (hidden at this help level)
locks.not_that_title: Not that: removed for this whole capture, the coach will not offer it again.
locks.either: Either your choice is wrong, or a mark is misread:
locks.misread_title: The reading of mark {n} is wrong: it will no longer count.
locks.question: {name}?
locks.city_placeholder: type the name (2 letters at least)…
locks.if_wrong: {text} If the country is wrong, click ✕.
label.link: Link of the real place (game's end screen → Google Maps), optional
label.link_help: The coach only reads the link's coordinates (it does not open it): the bench then also measures the region and the position's accuracy.
label.progress_model: StreetCLIP was right {top1} times out of {rounds}.
label.no_meta_yet: No meta separates these two countries yet: add yours in my-metas.toml.
map.aria: Map of the likely countries and the likely zones
map.region_framed: (framed on the extent of its places, without an outline)
map.greyed: Greyed out: {places}, read but outside your choice.
map.rough: Distances inconsistent with each other: check {doubtful}. A misread figure would give a false precision; certain all the same: the view is less than {km} km from {place}.
map.ring: About {km} km as the crow flies from {place}
map.ring_note: (a single place with its distance: the view is somewhere on this circle)
map.distances: Distances read: {list}. They are road distances: the coach converts them to straight-line distances (detour ×1.15 to ×1.45), hence the margin.
map.nearby: {list}: the view is in their surroundings (no distance read, no more precise position).
map.zones_why_ai: (read by the AI, to be confirmed)
map.almost_none_in: Almost no position falls in {country}: here are the zones of all the countries.
map.hidden: Hidden: they only come from the look of the view, and your marks locate the view far more precisely.
map.error: {error}: the map shows the countries only.
map.almost_none_proven: Almost no position falls in {country}: the map shows the proven country.
map.scattered: No clear zone: the positions are too scattered.
map.off: Zones turned off in the settings: the map shows the countries only.
map.lead: A lead, not a proof: the zones come from the same look of the view as StreetCLIP (PLONK model) and usually fall 100–300 km from the place when the country is right.
storage.summary: On disk: {total}. Growing caches: {growing} out of {max} at most (the least recently used go first). “Empty” never touches your test set, your metas or your config; “Erase everything”, below, does.
storage.erase_intro: Resets the application: everything about you is deleted from this computer, then the first launch starts again. Only the application's files go, never one of your folders.
storage.erased: Data erased: restart the application to start from scratch.
storage.precious: ⚠ precious: the basis of all the measurements, lost
storage.ui_state: Interface state and the application's GNOME shortcuts
storage.group.engine: Engine installed by GeoNesClick (Python and its libraries)
storage.also_note.models: (nothing personal; downloaded again at the next launch)
storage.also.engine: Also the engine installed by GeoNesClick (Python and its libraries)
storage.also_note.engine: (uninstalls GeoNesClick; with the models too, only the AppImage is left)
storage.uninstalled: GeoNesClick is uninstalled. You can delete the AppImage; opening it again reinstalls the engine.
field.rect: Four numbers expected: left, top, right, bottom.
field.rects: Each line: four numbers (left, top, right, bottom).
field.positive: A positive or zero number is expected.
field.country_invalid: The country's English name and its two-letter ISO code are expected.
setting.coach.help_level.hint: What shows on its own after a capture (also changeable at the top of the coach).
setting.coach.help_level.1.hint: Where to look, naming no country.
setting.coach.help_level.2.hint: Plus what the AI sees, including the text read.
setting.coach.help_level.3.hint: Plus the likely countries, the map, the clues and the tips.
setting.coach.help_level.4.hint: Plus the synthesis at the top: country, region, proof.
setting.coach.trust_proof.hint: A proof confirmed by the local rules on your marks (place names backed by a second proof) puts that country first, “certain”, and rules out the others. An AI reading alone stays “very likely”.
setting.coach.language.hint: The whole interface and the AI's answers. Spanish, German, Italian and Portuguese only translate the Plonk It tips for now.
setting.coach.leader_min: Minimum probability of a country given as the answer
setting.coach.leader_min.hint: Without proof read: below it, the coach talks of hesitation between the first countries.
setting.streetclip.countries.hint: Untick a country to rule it out of the analysis; add one by its English name and its ISO code.
setting.streetclip.prompt.hint: {} is replaced by each country's English name.
setting.vision.max_side_px.hint: Larger: the text reads better, the answer comes slower.
setting.metas.include_seed: Use the metas seed (established facts, not verified)
setting.metas.show_looks: Say what to observe before revealing the countries
setting.plonkit.enabled.hint: Collected on your machine for your own use, never redistributed.
setting.plonkit.similar_tips: Show the tips of the candidate countries
setting.plonkit.translate.hint: On demand, by the NVIDIA model; kept in cache.
setting.plonkit.pretranslate: Translate the whole base ahead of time, in the background
setting.plonkit.pretranslate.hint: Once and for all, after the rounds in progress: the tips then show translated right away.
setting.plonkit.translate_timeout_s.hint: Beyond it, the round's tips stay in English.
setting.plonkit.ai_classify: Have the AI classify the tips without a category
setting.metas.min_probability: Minimum probability of a candidate country
setting.metas.min_probability.hint: Countries kept to tell apart, above this threshold…
setting.metas.max_candidates: … and at most this number of countries
setting.metas.category_weights: Weight of each category in telling countries apart
setting.map.enabled.hint: Online OpenStreetMap background: the tile server sees your IP address and the areas shown.
setting.plonk.enabled.hint: About 120 MB of memory (the NVIDIA card's, otherwise RAM). A lead for the map, not a vote on the country.
setting.map.max_zoom.hint: 13: the streets around a position estimated from your marks. Higher: more tiles loaded online.
setting.plonk.steps.hint: 50 are enough (measured); below 25, the zones get worse.
setting.plonk.zone_share: Share of the positions covered by the zones
setting.plonk.zone_link_km.hint: Two positions closer than this go into the same zone.
setting.map.tile_filter: CSS filter of the tiles, from afar
setting.map.tile_filter.hint: Countries and zones. Empty: original map, not darkened.
setting.map.close_zoom: Zoom from which the map lightens
setting.map.close_zoom.hint: Up close, the darkened map makes villages and roads unreadable.
setting.map.tile_filter_close: CSS filter of the tiles, up close
setting.capture.save_to_disk: Keep a copy of the captures on disk
setting.capture.source.hint: Applied at the next start, or with “Change window”.
setting.capture.crop.hint: Fractions left, top, right, bottom (e.g. 0, 0.13, 1, 0.98); empty: whole image.
setting.capture.masks.hint: One rectangle per line, as fractions of the analysed area (e.g. the game's minimap).
setting.marks.enabled.hint: Freezes the view full screen: you draw a box around each clue, the AI copies the text of each one.
setting.marks.upscale_to_px.hint: Measured: a 140 px sign is misread as is, read exactly once enlarged ×3 (420 px).
setting.rules.scripts: The alphabet rules out the countries that do not write it
setting.rules.scripts.hint: Cyrillic in a mark excludes France, even if the AI “read” French on the whole view.
setting.rules.letters: Letters and street words specific to a language
setting.rules.letters.hint: “ъ” before a consonant: Bulgarian; “ő”: Hungarian; “utca”: Hungarian. Very likely country.
setting.rules.places.hint: Downloaded once (~11 MB, CC BY 4.0). Certain if confirmed by another proof and no mark contradicts it.
setting.rules.detail: Villages of the leading country (full directory)
setting.rules.detail.hint: Downloaded once per country (France 7.3 MB): finds the small villages (Laàs, L'Hôpital-d'Orion). GeoNames sees which country is looked up.
setting.rules.place_max_spread_km: Maximum spread between places of a round (km)
setting.rules.place_max_spread_km.hint: A namesake further from the other places read is ignored (“LAAS” → Lasa, in Italy).
setting.rules.prior_min: A lone place is confirmed if StreetCLIP gives its country
setting.rules.prior_min.hint: Otherwise it takes a 2nd nearby place, or a letter or a word of the country's language. Measured: 4 wrong lone places in one day.
setting.rules.place_min_len: Minimum length of a place name
setting.marks.parallel.hint: More: the marks come faster, at the risk of exceeding the API's limits.
setting.marks.prompt.hint: The model only copies: the coach draws the conclusions.
setting.locks.enabled: “Do you know where you are?”: certain country › region › city
setting.locks.enabled.hint: At the top of the coach: what is certain narrows the next search. You tell the coach, or it sets it alone when it is certain; ✕ to say “not that”. Lasts one capture.
setting.locks.auto_country: The coach sets the country alone when your marks make it certain
setting.locks.auto_region: … and the region when the position is clear or 2 places read agree
setting.locks.auto_region.hint: A sign with consistent distances, and all the places around the point in the same region.
setting.locks.propose_city: The coach suggests a city (“Yes” to keep it)
setting.locks.propose_city.hint: Never locked alone: a “Pau 40 km” sign names a place where you are not.
setting.locks.region_radius_km: Radius around the point for the region (km)
setting.locks.region_radius_km.hint: All the places within this distance of the point must be in the same region.
setting.locks.region_places_km: Without a distance read: maximum gap between 2 places of the region (km)
setting.locks.region_places_km.hint: At least two places read in the same region, closer than this distance: the region is set.
setting.dataset.enabled.hint: The capture and the real country join the test set, which is used to measure the coach.
setting.dataset.ask_guessed: Ask for the country I had answered
setting.dataset.ask_guessed.hint: Otherwise, a simple “Had you found it?” Yes / No.
setting.storage.max_cache_mb: Maximum size of the growing caches (MB)
setting.storage.max_cache_mb.hint: Villages of the countries met. The base never goes on its own.
setting.debug.enabled.hint: Keeps a log of each analysis (countries, zones, what the AI read) next to its capture, to review a round afterwards.
setting.coach.language.es: Español (Plonk It tips only, interface in English)
setting.coach.language.de: Deutsch (Plonk It tips only, interface in English)
setting.coach.language.it: Italiano (Plonk It tips only, interface in English)
setting.coach.language.pt: Português (Plonk It tips only, interface in English)
settings.saved_restart: Saved: applied at the next start.
settings.title: Settings
settings.applies_now: Each change applies and is saved right away.
settings.change_window_hint: Another browser, screen or resolution: reopens GNOME's picker.
settings.key_none: None: the in-depth analysis and the marks reading are off.
settings.key_where_before: Free on build.nvidia.com (“Get API Key”). Stored in
settings.key_where_after: , readable by you only; never shown again.
settings.file_only: Reserved to the file {file}, for security:
setup.when.option: once, if the option is on
setup.sent.nvidia: Online analysis (NVIDIA): the screenshots, the marked areas and the Plonk It tips to classify and translate are sent to NVIDIA, only if an API key is provided.
setup.sent.tiles: Map background (OpenStreetMap): the map server receives the IP address and the areas shown.
setup.option.places.detail: Recognises the towns read on signs and their region; then, on demand, the villages of the leading country.
setup.option.plonkit.detail: Tips per country close to the captured view, translated by the AI if an API key is provided.
setup.option.map.detail: Map tab: countries, places read, estimated position. The map server receives the IP address and the areas shown.
setup.option.plonk.detail: Computed locally, about 120 MB of extra memory (the NVIDIA card's, otherwise RAM). Indicative, not a proof.
setup.key.incomplete: Incomplete key: copy it whole from build.nvidia.com.

setup.system.missing: Missing components. Install them here (your system asks for your password) or with the following command, then check again:

setup.no_nvidia: No NVIDIA card detected: processor version.

setup.optional.title: Optional components

setup.key.help: Free on build.nvidia.com. Needed to read the text and the signs. Stored in a file readable by the user only.
setup.shortcuts.detail: Super+Shift+G to capture, Super+Shift+Z to mark.

download.python.why: run the analysis engine without touching your system's Python
download.packages.what: The engine's Python libraries (PyTorch, Transformers, FastAPI…), pinned versions checked by hash
download.packages.license: various (BSD, MIT, Apache-2.0…), detailed package by package below
download.packages.why: the engine: local analysis of the view, the interface's server, reading the AI's answers
download.pytorch-cpu.what: PyTorch for processor (instead of the CUDA version, without an NVIDIA card)
download.pytorch-cpu.why: run StreetCLIP without an NVIDIA graphics card (slower)
download.streetclip.what: StreetCLIP model (geolocal/StreetCLIP, pinned version, safetensors weights)
download.streetclip.why: recognise the country from the look of the view, locally (level 1)
download.geonames.what: GeoNames place directory (towns of more than 1,000 inhabitants) and region names
download.geonames.why: recognise the place names read on your marks, and the regions
download.villages.what: Villages of a country (full GeoNames directory of the leading country)
download.villages.why: find the small villages read on a sign; GeoNames sees which country is looked up
download.plonkit.what: Plonk It guides (84 pages), then an update check every 30 days
download.plonkit.license: no reuse licence: collected for your personal use, never redistributed
download.plonkit.why: tips per country that look like your view (GeoGuessr mode)
download.plonk.why: likely zones on the map, computed locally (+120 MB of video memory)
download.nvidia.what: Analysis by the NVIDIA vision model (online API)
download.nvidia.license: terms of use of the NVIDIA API (build.nvidia.com); your API key
download.nvidia.why: read the text of the view and of your marks, classify and translate the tips
download.nvidia.sends: your captures (shrunk to 1,280 px), the crops of your marks, and the Plonk It tips to classify and translate
download.tiles.license: data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); OSMF tile usage policy
download.tiles.why: show the map under the countries, zones and places
download.tiles.sends: your IP address and the map areas shown
overlay.full: {max} marks at most: confirm or remove the last one.
overlay.box: Draw a box around each clue: street sign, road sign, shop sign…
overlay.new_round: New round? Cancel, capture (Super+Shift+G), then mark.
config.rect_count: {name}: 4 values expected [left, top, right, bottom], {count} received
config.rect_fractions: {name}: fractions between 0 and 1 expected, with left < right and top < bottom
config.negative_weight: a weight must be positive or zero
config.clip_prompt: the prompt must contain {} once (the country's name) and no other brace
settings.why.network: the engine's network: it must listen only to your machine and your coach window
settings.why.key: would redirect your API key to another server
settings.why.disk: a path on the disk: a request must not be able to make the engine write elsewhere
settings.why.model: a model downloaded then run on your machine: a trapped model could run code
settings.why.csp: must also be allowed in the window (CSP and Tauri permissions)
settings.why.source: a source downloaded then read on your machine: it must not be diverted

lang.russian_central_asian: Russian or a Central Asian language
lang.west_south_slavic: a West or South Slavic language

places.street: street name: does not locate the view

marks.off: marks turned off in the settings
marks.capture_first: take a capture first: the marks complete the analysis of a round
marks.frozen_unknown: frozen view too old or unknown

seed.language_fi.hint: Finnish: ä, ö, doubled letters (“katu”, “tie”); sometimes bilingual with Swedish
seed.language_ee.hint: Estonian: õ (specific to Estonian in the region), ä, ö, ü; “tee”, “tänav”
seed.language_lv.hint: Latvian: long vowels with a macron (ā, ē, ī, ū), ļ, ņ, ķ, ģ; “iela”
seed.language_lt.hint: Lithuanian: ą, ę, ė, į, ų, ū; “gatvė”
seed.language_pl.hint: Polish: ł, ą, ę, ś, ź, ż, ń; “ulica” (ul.)
seed.language_sk.hint: Slovak: ä, ľ, ĺ, ŕ, ô; “ulica”
seed.language_si.hint: Slovenian: č, š, ž but neither ć nor đ; “cesta”, “ulica”
seed.language_hr.hint: Croatian: Latin alphabet only, with č, ć, đ, š, ž
seed.language_rs.hint: Serbian: Cyrillic, often with Latin (đ, ć, č)
seed.language_me_mk.hint: Cyrillic and Latin possible (as in Serbia)
seed.language_bg.hint: Bulgarian: Cyrillic, with a very frequent ъ
seed.language_ua.hint: Ukrainian: Cyrillic with і, ї, є
seed.language_ro.hint: Romanian: ă, â, î, ș, ț; “strada”
seed.language_ch.hint: German without ß, French or Italian depending on the region
seed.language_be.hint: French or Dutch depending on the region
seed.language_es.hint: Spanish: ñ; “calle” (sometimes Catalan, Basque or Galician)
seed.language_tr.hint: Turkish: ı (dotless i), ğ, ş, ç; “cadde”, “sokak”
seed.road_lines_yellow.look: the colour of the centre line
seed.road_lines_white.look: the colour of the centre line
category.language.look: the letters and words of the signs and shop signs
category.driving.look: the side of the road where the cars drive and park
